name: ChatQT
tagline: A simple AI chat client for OpenAI-compatible providers
blurb: ChatQT is a native KDE application that provides a simple and intuitive interface for chatting with AI models via OpenAI-compatible APIs.
description:
ChatQT is a native KDE application that provides a simple and intuitive interface for
chatting with AI models via OpenAI-compatible APIs.

Multiple provider support: Connect to Ollama, OpenClaw, or any OpenAI-compatible API.

Simple interface: Clean and intuitive design built with Kirigami for a seamless experience.

Native KDE integration: Built with Qt/QML for seamless Plasma desktop experience.

Chat management: Clear chat history and control auto-scroll behavior.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
